snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.7 - Visual changes + Secret Bad Ending!
snippet.description:
Over the next 3 videos (this one + the next 2), these updates will be smaller and focused on changing fewer things.

↓↓↓ Update V1.7 Log ↓↓↓

- Recreated desks with custom 3D models instead of 2D PNGs
- Added custom 3D book models to classrooms
- Added secret bad ending! You must complete Classic Mode without picking up any items to get this ending.
- Removed the Golden Orb debug item

Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets in game are created by me!
